function.name: archival_memory_add
function.description: This tool belongs to the memory suite, which provides APIs to interact with a key-value based memory system. Tool description: Add a new entry to the archival memory. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

text.description: The text to be added to the archival memory.

id.description: The ID of the added entry, which can be used later for deletion or retrieval.

function.name: archival_memory_remove
function.description: This tool belongs to the memory suite, which provides APIs to interact with a key-value based memory system. Tool description: Remove an entry from the archival memory. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

vec_id.description: The ID of the entry to be removed.

function.name: archival_memory_retrieve
function.description: This tool belongs to the memory suite, which provides APIs to interact with a key-value based memory system. Tool description: Retrieve the most similar entries from the archival memory. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

query.description: The query text to search for.

top_k.description: The number of top similar entries to retrieve.

results.description: A list of dictionaries containing the ID, similarity score, and text of the retrieved entries.

similarity_score.description: The similarity score of the entry with respect to the query.

function.description: This tool belongs to the memory suite, which provides APIs to interact with a key-value based memory system. Tool description: Retrieve all entries from the archival memory. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

results.description: A list of dictionaries containing the ID and text of all entries.
